headline: Preparing for the Community Planning Workshop, a fall citywide community engagement event.
summary: Discussion covers preparations for the fall Community Planning Workshop. Agency Landscape + Planning, the project consultant, will attend.
items: Discussion and preparation for the Community Planning Workshop on November 7, 2026, with consultant Agency Landscape + Planning
location: Malden City Hall, Conference Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA

COMPREHENSIVE MASTER PLAN STEERING COMMITTEE 
  
MEETING 
  
The Comprehensive Master Plan Steering Committee will hold a meeting in Malden City 
Hall, Conference Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, at 1:00 PM on                      
Thursday, November 5, 2026. 
     AGENDA   
 
1. Call to Order. 
2. Roll Call. 
3. Fall Citywide community engagement event, Community Planning Workshop,  
November 7, 2026 – discussion and preparation for event with project consultant, Agency 
Landscape + Planning, who will be in attendance. 
4. Any other business properly before the Committee. 
5. Adjournment. 
 
                                                      By:  Charles Ioven, Chair 
                                                              Planning Board   
  Comprehensive Master Plan Steering Committee 
 
 
 If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance 
Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000, Ext 2005.
